user.title: Add an ArcGIS layer
user.description: Pick a known layer, or point at any ArcGIS feature layer of polygons.

preset.title: Name and location
preset.description: The sensor turns on when a feature of {layer_url} covers this location. By default the location stays in Home Assistant: the layer's in-effect features are downloaded and checked here.

custom.title: Custom layer
custom.description: Give the URL of an ArcGIS FeatureServer or MapServer layer of polygons, ending in the layer number (for example `.../FeatureServer/0`). By default the location stays in Home Assistant: features matching the where clause are downloaded and checked here.

data_description.where: An SQL filter the layer applies, such as `Status = 'active'`. `1=1` matches every feature.
data_description.title_field: The field whose value of the first matching feature becomes the sensor's `title` attribute. Optional.

error.invalid_layer: The URL did not answer as an ArcGIS layer.
error.not_polygon: The layer's geometry is not polygons.
error.no_query: The layer does not allow queries.

abort.already_configured: This layer, filter, and location are already configured.

data_description.query_mode: Local keeps the location in Home Assistant. Server sends the location to the layer's host, for layers too large to download.

options.local: Local: download features, check the location in Home Assistant
options.server: Server: send the location to the layer's host
